overview: The big tech news is Microsoft and NVIDIA launching a reworked Windows built for personal agents, and Coinbase bringing USDC to Samsung Wallet in the US. Elon Musk spent the night promoting Grok Bot's new features and Starlink's push into India and Bangladesh. Much of Bill Ackman's feed was October 7 politics, which is skipped here except for one Fannie/Freddie post.

top_items.title: Jensen Huang - NVIDIA and Microsoft unveil a new chapter for Windows, which Huang calls reinvented for personal agents after 4 years of joint work
Brian Armstrong - USDC is coming to Samsung Wallet as its first supported stablecoin, powered by Coinbase, available soon in the US
Elon Musk - Grok Bot can now search, read and monitor X, link to bank accounts per promoters, and run team bots in Slack
Elon Musk - Endorses Paul Graham's view that Amazon banning agents opens the first real opening for an Amazon competitor
Elon Musk - Starlink Mobile is live in Bangladesh with Banglalink, reaching millions in cellular dead zones, as Musk pushes for India entry
Demis Hassabis - Shares Google's launch of EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open multimodal embedding model built for on-device efficiency
Yann LeCun - Shares a Meta paper reporting scaling laws for robot world models, using an 8B-parameter JEPA model
Jeff Dean - Mourns Margaret Hamilton, who led the Apollo flight software at MIT, after MIT announced her death at 90
